source.scope: Retained official Flash client configuration. Target and level evidence is separate from the user-approved remake behavior.

remakePolicy.mechanical-level: Automatically evolve mechanical species along source-backed single-target, resource-free trigger edges at their source level.
remakePolicy.branch-choice: Retain every target and source level at the six traditional branch points; replace item costs with an explicit manual target choice.
remakePolicy.special-source-level: Retain the three meaningful source item-trigger levels, 63, 34, and 40, while removing item costs and requiring manual confirmation.
remakePolicy.special-remake-override: Replace the three original item-trigger levels of 1, for 347 to 729, 601 to 881, and 55 to 1143, with explicit remake level 60 and manual confirmation. Preserve the original value 1 in source evidence.
remakePolicy.special-remake-level: Use the canonical mature predecessor for single-target special forms. Where the pinned source has no target-specific level, retain remake level 60, then 70 and 80 for successive special stages; every transition requires manual confirmation.
remakePolicy.special-branch-choice: The two genuine special forks, from 67 and 739, require a manual choice at remake level 60.
remakePolicy.specialConfirmation: All 32 special and super-evolution transitions require an explicit player action. None triggers automatically from training, experience, level items, or loading an existing save.
remakePolicy.canonicalAncestry: The source SuperEvolves record for 1459 accepts 77, 78, and 79. Use mature 79 in both the forward rule and runtime reverse ancestry; preserve the original EvolvesFrom 77 in provenance. Do not add infancy-to-super shortcuts.
remakePolicy.repeatAcquisition: Branch-family initial forms must remain repeatedly obtainable under the existing six-per-species cap; this generator does not change acquisition limits or historical repeatability evidence.
remakePolicy.sourceBoundary: Fallback levels and the three level-1-to-60 overrides are explicit remake decisions. The pinned XML establishes target relationships and original gates; complete historical activity and server-side restrictions remain unverified.
remakePolicy.exclusions: Do not infer target-specific source levels from another ordinary edge; do not add unreviewed forms outside the 32 historical v33 omissions.
